name: Carmine Moon
source:
After receiving a mysterious letter from a client requesting your detective services, you are haunted by the visit of the vampire who's tormenting the city.  Upon getting a deadline from the murderer themselves, you must interrogate locals and investigate the evidences you find, while dealing with your own inner demons.

[From [url=https://bely.itch.io/carmine-moon]itch.io[/url]]
